verdict.rationale: Vercel does integrate with existing Git repos (push-to-deploy) and offers a CLI that fits into normal workflows, but community evidence suggests real lock-in: users say there's 'no serious reason to use Vercel, other than for those being locked into the NextJs ecosystem,' and complain about restrictive language support ('we only get JS/TS/Go') and needing to leave for tools like Dokploy for full control.
